about.title: Company Overview
about.intro1: Vietex Global is a Vietnam-based agricultural and seafood export company. We are not just a farm or a factory — we are the dedicated partner that sits between carefully selected Vietnamese producers and buyers around the world.
about.intro2: Sourcing directly overseas creates real friction: language barriers, inconsistent quality, unfamiliar paperwork and the risk of a shipment failing inspection on arrival. Vietex removes that friction. We vet suppliers, control quality before loading, prepare complete export documentation, and stay accountable for the consignment until it reaches you.

about.directorQuote: "At Vietex, we believe that true partnership is built on transparency and reliability. faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products, services, and export processes.
faq.a1: Vietex Global is a Vietnam-based B2B agricultural products exporter. We connect international importers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and foodservice buyers with quality Vietnamese products, particularly canned fruits and processed agricultural goods.
faq.q2: What products does Vietex Global export?
faq.a2: Our product portfolio includes canned pineapple, canned lychee, canned longan, canned coconut, canned lime, and other Vietnamese agricultural products. Product availability may vary depending on the harvest season, processing schedule, and buyer requirements.
faq.q3: Does Vietex Global provide OEM and private-label services?
faq.a3: Yes. Vietex Global supports OEM and private-label orders for international buyers. Depending on the product and order quantity, we can discuss customized labels, packaging formats, product specifications, carton designs, and other branding requirements.
faq.a4: Halal-certified options may be available depending on the selected product and manufacturing facility. Buyers should provide their target market and certification requirements so our team can verify the appropriate factory and documentation before preparing a quotation.
faq.q5: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a5: The minimum order quantity depends on the product, packaging format, label requirements, and destination market. Please share your expected order volume with us, and our team will recommend a suitable MOQ and purchasing option.
faq.q6: Can I request product samples before placing an order?
faq.a6: Yes, buyers can contact Vietex Global to request product samples for quality evaluation. Sample availability, sample costs, and international courier fees will be confirmed based on the product and delivery destination.
faq.a7: Packaging options vary by product and may include different can sizes, carton specifications, retail packaging, and foodservice formats. OEM buyers may also request customized labels and packaging, subject to technical feasibility and minimum order requirements.
faq.q8: How can I request a quotation from Vietex Global?
faq.a8: You can submit a Request for Quotation through our website. Please provide your company name, country, product of interest, expected quantity, packaging requirements, certification needs, OEM or private-label requirements, destination port, and preferred delivery timeline. Our team will review your request and contact you with the relevant product specifications, pricing, and estimated lead time.

csrPolicy.intro: At Vietex, we believe that true business success goes hand-in-hand with environmental stewardship and social equity. Our commitment extends beyond trade to the communities and lands that make our products possible.
csrPolicy.p1Desc: Details about sustainable sourcing, reducing carbon footprint, eco-friendly packaging initiatives, and responsible waste management across our entire supply chain.
csrPolicy.p2Desc: Unwavering commitment to fair compensation for farmers, safe working conditions, and ethical labor practices. We empower the people who grow our products.
csrPolicy.p3Desc: Maintaining total transparency, strict anti-corruption policies, and rigid compliance with international trade laws and quality standards at every step.
